item.title: INACTIVE: Banked resets re-issued after a morning apply failure
item.description: Tibo said some banked resets did not fully apply this morning on ChatGPT Work and Codex. Affected users are getting another banked reset and an apology email. Banked-only events do not turn Tibo Time on.
